name: My Cookie Store 🍪[BETA]
desc:
🍂 HARVEST FEST IS HERE!
Unlock 20 tiers of autumn treats and cute toppers! Earn free rewards through Nov 30! 🦃

🍪 Design, bake, box and sell your cookies
🥤 Mix drinks! FREE Drink Station at Level 6
🏪 Hire staff and build your dream bakery
📖 Create your Menu and Signature treats
👫 Play with friends for bonus cash

💬 Keep sharing ideas and reporting bugs! ❤️

This game is still in it's early stages, the team is fully striving hard to ensure everything can work as smoothly as possible for everyone, happy baking!

llm.loop: bake, decorate and box cookies -> sell to customers -> hire staff, expand bakery and recipes -> seasonal reward tiers
llm.objectives: build your dream bakery and design signature treats
llm.progression: level unlocks (drink station at L6), recipes, decor, staff, event tiers
llm.instructions: design, bake, box and sell cookies; mix drinks; hire staff; create your menu
unique: detailed cookie design and boxing with customization
llm.thumbnails: a chocolate-chip cookie icon and a box of decorated cookies
llm.complexity_notes: cooking stations, customer AI, decoration editor, plots
